{{Top|leg}}
'''Verlen''' were a type of predator. They were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]].

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the child [[Zanner]] and his pet [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] calf got lost in the woods on [[Dalicron-4]] during a storm. A group of verlen caught the scent of the calf and attacked the creature. A bolt of lightning then brought a tree down on Zanner, stopping the verlen from being able to reach him and devour him as well. The verlen waited by the tree and were attacked by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents who came to rescue Zanner.
